questions.q: What does the core `[Total Revenue]` measure look like, and why does it need no unit conversion?
options: `SUM(fct_orders[amount]) / 100` — the conversion has to happen here in DAX
`SUM(fct_orders[amount])` — amount was already converted from cents to dollars in Lesson 7's staging model
`COUNT(fct_orders[order_id])` — revenue is a row count, not a sum
`AVERAGE(fct_orders[amount])` — Finance wants an average, not a total
questions.explain: Because cents_to_dollars() was applied in stg_jaffle_shop__payments back in Lesson 7, amount already arrives in dollars by the time it reaches this measure.

questions.q: What two visuals together answer Finance's actual ask from Lesson 1?
options: Revenue over time (by order_date) and revenue by payment method
A map visual showing order locations
A single pie chart of customer names
A table of every raw_payments row with no aggregation
questions.explain: Finance asked for revenue by day and by payment method — exactly what these two visuals provide.

questions.q: What does the `Revenue MTD` measure use to compute month-to-date revenue?
options: `[Total Revenue] - [Revenue Last Month]`
`CALCULATE([Total Revenue], DATESMTD(fct_orders[order_date]))`
`CALCULATE([Total Revenue], ALL(fct_orders))`
`SUM(fct_orders[amount]) * 30`
questions.explain: DATESMTD is the real time-intelligence function for a month-to-date window, applied as the filter argument to CALCULATE.

questions.q: What sanity check should be run before trusting this page?
options: Check that the Power BI file size is under 1 GB
Confirm the page loads in under 5 seconds
Compare [Total Revenue] with no filters against a plain sum(amount) run directly in Snowflake against fct_orders
There's no meaningful sanity check available for this page
questions.explain: Comparing the unfiltered Power BI total against the same aggregation run directly in the warehouse is the real check for model-level correctness.
